text: Atlas PRD v2 is up for review: https://wiki.northwind.dev/product/atlas-prd. Big changes: fleet scheduling moved to GA scope, OTA updates stay beta.
OTA beta is the right call. I don't want customers pushing firmware fleet-wide without guardrails.
I'll have onboarding flow wireframes by Friday: connect site → claim robots → invite team.
From the field: every enterprise prospect asks about SSO in the first call. Please keep it in GA.
